lines.text: The Philistines fought Israel on Mount Gilboa, and they killed Saul's sons Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.
Archers wounded Saul critically, and he asked his armor-bearer to run him through with a sword.
When the armor-bearer refused, Saul fell on his own sword, and the armor-bearer did the same.
The Philistines cut off Saul's head and hung his body on the wall of Jericho.
The men of Jabesh burned the bodies, buried the bones under a tamarisk tree, and fasted twelve days.
